segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ אֵין חוֹשְׁשִׁין שֶׁמָּא גֵּירְרָה חוּלְדָּה מִבַּיִת לְבַיִת וּמִמָּקוֹם לְמָקוֹם, דְּאִם כֵּן מֵחָצֵר לְחָצֵר וּמֵעִיר לָעִיר — אֵין לַדָּבָר סוֹף.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» After conducting the search, «one» need «not» be «concerned that perhaps a marten dragged» leaven «from house to house, or from place to place,» placing leaven in a house that was already searched. «As if so,» one need also be concerned that perhaps leaven might have been dragged «from courtyard to courtyard and from city to city.» In that case, «there is no end to the matter,» and it would be impossible to rely on any search for leaven.

moves.summary: no concern about a marten dragging leaven, else there is no end

positions.claim: one need not fear a marten dragged leaven into a searched place, or there would be no end
